reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a piano-key-style panel for navigating between user-message turns within the current conversation, with hover previews, scrolling highlights, and theme-aware styling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加会话内钢琴键风格导航条，帮助用户按用户消息快速定位对话轮次并查看悬停预览。
summaries.en: Adds a piano-key-style navigation bar to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for locating conversation turns and previewing messages within the current session.

capabilities: Adds an in-conversation navigation bar to the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Reads conversation snapshots and message DOM anchors to map navigation keys to user messages
Displays truncated user and model message previews on hover
Jumps to selected conversation messages when clicked
Adapts the navigation bar to light and dark themes
